name: Dwarven Home
desc1: This comfortable house is somewhat cramped for anyone taller than a
desc2: dwarf. Dwarves take pride in their homes, and this is easily seen
desc3: here-- everything is tidy, well-kept, and of excellent quality. A
desc4: large wooden table stands in the centre of this room, surrounded by
desc5: four carved chairs. Shelves are piled with crockey and cookware,
desc6: and a large stone fireplace burns brightly and with great warmth.
